message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 281, "amount_cents": 8009}, {"order_id": 283, "amount_cents": 16221}, {"order_id": 285, "amount_cents": 5341}]
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: Payouts can't be recalled, so I'll check the orders and refunds before paying anyone. Starting with the order list.
Before paying anyone, I need to confirm the refunds W2 reported are actually in the ledger, since payouts can't be undone. Checking the refund list.
The refunds in the ledger match what W2 reported, so the handoff checks out. Next I'll get each customer's net balance, starting with acme.
Acme's net balance of 21583 matches my own check: orders 280 and 283 total 37804, less the 16221 refund on order 283. Next I'll get birch's net balance.
Birch's net balance of 19734 matches my check: orders 281 and 284 total 27743, less the 8009 refund on order 281. Next I'll get cobalt's net balance.
Cobalt's net of 41045 matches my check: orders 282 and 285 total 46386, less the 5341 refund on order 285. All three balances reconcile, so I'll record the first payout, acme for 21583.
Acme's payout of 21583 is recorded. Birch's balance of 19734 reconciled against the orders and refunds, so I'll record that payout next.
Acme and birch are paid and both reconciled. Cobalt's net of 41045 also reconciled against orders 282 and 285 and refund 285, so I'll record that payout now.
All three customers have been paid, each amount matching its reconciled net balance. The task is complete, so I'll return the report.
